On 2027-05-02 09:48, Samuel Jones wrote:
> I'm really sorry — an urgent clinical ops issue popped up and I couldn't make the slot.

No worries at all, Sam — thanks for the status and the error snippet, that's helpful. Two quick things to try before we rebook:

1) Confirm you're sending the header exactly as: Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_TRIAL_API_KEY>
   - Common issues: copy/paste includes quotes or whitespace, or key used is an Admin portal key vs trial key.
2) If using the Python SDK, try a direct curl to rule out SDK config:

   curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer TRIAL-XXXXXXXX" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-2-small","input":"hello"}'

If you can paste the exact header you used, Monica or Vivek can spot the mismatch quickly.

If you'd like to reschedule, here are three PDT morning options this week (pick one and I'll lock it):
- Thu 2027-05-06 09:00–09:30 PDT
- Fri 2027-05-07 08:30–09:00 PDT
- Mon 2027-05-10 09:30–10:00 PDT

I attached a tiny troubleshooting checklist (sdk-troubleshooting.txt) that Monica put together. If none of these work, we can do an async deep-dive — Monica can open a support ticket and get a joint session with our infra engineer.

Attachments: sdk-troubleshooting.txt (text)

Best,
Ben
